title: Present Perfect or Past Simple?
ringkas: Waktu jelas vs tidak jelas, ever/never, just/yet, last year, ago
goals: memilih tense dari **kata petunjuk waktu**: yesterday, ago, last, in 2020 vs ever, never, already, yet, just

lesson.text: Ini pasangan tense yang paling sering membingungkan. Aturan emasnya sederhana: **kalau waktunya jelas disebut (yesterday, last week, in 2020), pakai past simple. Kalau waktunya tidak disebut dan yang penting adalah hubungan dengan sekarang, pakai present perfect.**

examples.en: [[I lost my keys yesterday.]] / [[I have lost my keys.]]
examples.id: Kemarin aku menghilangkan kunci. / Kunciku hilang (dan masih belum ketemu).

lesson.title: 3. Pertanyaan: When atau Have you ever?
table: [[When did you visit Bali?]] — [[I visited it in 2020.]]

examples.id: Kamu sudah menonton film ini? — Ya, aku menontonnya minggu lalu. (beralih ke past simple saat waktunya disebut)

Maya: Ya, pernah. Saya bekerja di bank pada tahun 2019.
Interviewer: Kapan Anda berhenti?

Interviewer: Sudahkah Anda menyelesaikan kursus?

read.text:
Interviewer: Have you ever worked in a bank?
Maya: Yes, I have. I worked in a bank in 2019.
Interviewer: When did you leave?
Maya: I left last year. Since then, I have been studying.
Interviewer: Have you finished your course?
Maya: Not yet. I have completed two modules, but I haven't taken the final exam.
read.title: A Job Interview

read.id: Aku memulai pekerjaan pertamaku pada tahun 2019. Aku bekerja di toko kecil selama dua tahun. Aku belajar berbicara dengan pelanggan, dan aku punya banyak teman. Pada tahun 2021, aku berhenti karena pindah ke kota lain. Sejak itu, aku bekerja di kantor. Aku telah bertemu banyak orang menarik, dan belajar banyak. Aku tidak pernah menyesali pilihanku.

read.text: I started my first job in 2019. I worked in a small shop for two years. I learned how to talk to customers, and I made many friends. In 2021, I left because I moved to another city. Since then, I have worked in an office. I have met many interesting people, and I have learned a lot. I have never regretted my choice.
read.title: My First Job

Budi: Yes, I have. I went there in 2021.
